buildNote: weapp-vite build -p web failed on the committed fixtures because the web runtime cannot resolve wxs-to-wxs require (format.wxs -> arithmetic.wxs). For this measurement the dependency was inlined in a build copy; the committed suite is unchanged.
driverNote: Results were collected through the page instance (window probes) because the runtime never renders page data into the DOM, so DOM-based completion detection stalls.
keyFindings: Build: wxs-to-wxs require is unsupported and fails the build (inlined for this run).
Template data spread {{...payload}} cannot be parsed; template-probe never mounts, timing out all 16 template, 7 expression and 3 wxs template cases.

wx.onError, wx.onUnhandledRejection, wx.getPerformance, wx.arrayBufferToBase64, wx.canvasGetImageData, wx.createWorker, wx.createMediaQueryObserver and getFileSystemManager are absent, zeroing the error, base64, canvas, worker, clock and file-system groups.
Component hasBehavior and getRelationNodes are missing (behavior/relation groups fail); generic components do not expose their methods.
Dataset and WXS-rendered values arrive as strings, breaking typed expectations (query.typed-dataset, wxs.state group).
selectComponent wrappers do not retain instance method state (component.instance-data snapshots stay empty).
Module loading diverges: directory shorthand is accepted, cycle partial exports leak a string, and a failing module is cached as if it succeeded.

Lifecycle order adds beta.hide before beta.unload on back-navigation; focus/blur details carry no numeric height and extra events; form reset reports an empty slider string (already recorded for the browser host).
getSavedFileList and onReachBottom behavior matched the official-host notes; navigation cases pass with the suite's getCurrentPages polling fallback now that wx.onAppRouteDone is optional.
